title: Installed applications
whyItMatters: The list of installed apps shows which services and cloud clients may still hold sign-ins or licenses that need attention.
source: Apple macOS user guide: /Applications contains the apps installed for all users
notes: Names only, no recursion into app bundles. Apps installed under ~/Applications or elsewhere are out of scope.

cleanup.signOut: Sign out of any account inside each app before it is removed, so it is no longer a signed-in device.
steps: List the apps in the plan you no longer need, and open each one to sign out first.
Quit the app, then drag it from the Applications folder to the Trash.
Empty the Trash, then check the folders in the plan for leftover support files.
cleanup.risk: The apps and their settings are gone; anything you still want must be downloaded and set up again.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Delete files and folders on Mac: https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/delete-files-and-folders-on-mac-mchlp1093/mac
